name: deepcode-runtime-venv
python_build: python-build-standalone 20260807 cpython-3.12.13 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu install_only_stripped (python3.12 sha256 021044895e95be79dc2f110367607e684119afbc8ce75f6f0eec94844e0acec7), the same build as deeptutor-task-env-v1 and as the paper venv's base interpreter
used_as: the DeepCode product's runtime Python, executed on the host inside bubblewrap (evaluator/harness/deepcode_lower_agent.py read-only binds the venv prefix found through bin/../pyvenv.cfg and its base prefix); the formal command passes --python @@AGENTSWE_ENVS@@/deepcode-runtime-venv/bin/python (formal_commands.DEEPCODE_PYTHON) and the readiness launcher sets DEEPCODE_PYTHON to the same path
layout: <env dir> is the virtualenv itself (python at <env dir>/bin/python, pyvenv.cfg at <env dir>/pyvenv.cfg)
paper: the paper's formal cells used a venv that an earlier readiness run had prepared with the tree's own prepare_task_environment.py (unpinned `pip install -r evaluator/harness/deepcode-runtime-requirements.txt` on CPython 3.12.13, 2026-09-08); requirements.lock pins exactly the 84 distributions installed there (name, version and wheel, with PyPI file hashes); pip 25.0.1 comes from the interpreter's ensurepip, as it did there
notes: Must be built on the host because bubblewrap runs it from host paths. build-host.sh installs the pinned CPython with uv into $AGENTSWE_HOME/python, creates the venv at the env dir and installs requirements.lock with --require-hashes --no-deps --no-compile.
